subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a 'fundamental right' in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Speech**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the Indian Constitution, the right to speech is part of the Right to Freedom of Speech and Expression, which is a fundamental right under Article 19.
 
• However, the term "Right to Speech" alone is not listed as a fundamental right. 
 
• It is framed under the broader concept of **freedom of speech and expression**.
 
• This right is one of the fundamental rights but is subject to limitations, such as:
 
 
• **Security of the State**
 
• **Public Order**
 
• **Decency or Morality**
 
• **Contempt of Court**
 
• **Defamation**
 
• **Incitement to an offence**
 
 
 
• So, while "Right to Speech" is essentially covered under **Article 19(1)(a)**, it is not listed as "Right to Speech" by name in the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Freedom**:

 
 
• **Articles 19 to 22 deal with various freedoms** such as speech, movement, assembly, etc.
 
• It **ensures various freedoms essential for the development of individuals** and the democratic framework of the country.
 
 
 
• **Cultural and Educational Rights**:
 
 
• **Articles 29 and 30 ensure the protection of the rights of minorities** in matters of culture and education.
 
• It** ensures that India’s rich cultural and linguistic heritage is protected.**
 
• It facilitates harmony by recognizing and respecting cultural differences.
 
 
 
• **Right to Equality**:
 
 
• **Articles 14 to 18 ensure equality before the law and prohibition of discrimination.**
 
• Guarantees the same legal rights and protections for all citizens.
